# runbook-linker

> Check that every Prometheus alert links to a runbook that exists: local files, heading anchors, base-URL mapping, path containment and suggested links for missing ones Python package `trysac-runbook-linker`, import name `runbook_linker`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
